# react-icon-transition

> Smooth, reversible transitions between any React SVG icons. ~2.9 KB gzip. Client component for React 18+.

Animate any two React SVG icons with `IconTransition`. Supports geometry morph (`liquid`) and scale/blur/fade swap (`blur`). Mid-toggle reverse is continuous. Honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Install

```sh
bun add react-icon-transition
# or: npm install react-icon-transition
```

Peer dependencies: `react`, `react-dom`.

## Quick start

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Pause, Play } from "lucide-react";
import { IconTransition } from "react-icon-transition";

export function PlayerButton() {
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);

  return (
    <button onClick={() => setPlaying((value) => !value)}>
      <IconTransition
        status={playing}
        default={<Play style={{ color: "green" }} />}
        target={Pause}
        duration={300}
        easing="ease-in-out"
        type="liquid"
      />
    </button>
  );
}
```

Works with Lucide, Heroicons, inline `<svg>`, or any other React SVG icon component/element.

## API

Exported: `IconTransition`, types `IconTransitionProps`, `IconTransitionSource`, `IconTransitionEasing`, `IconTransitionType`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `boolean` | required | `false` shows `default`, `true` shows `target` |
| `default` | `ComponentType \| ReactElement` | required | Outgoing / off-state icon |
| `target` | `ComponentType \| ReactElement` | required | Incoming / on-state icon |
| `duration` | `number` | `300` | Milliseconds for a full 0→1 transition; mid-toggle uses remaining distance |
| `easing` | `linear \| ease \| ease-in \| ease-out \| ease-in-out` | `ease-in-out` | Timing curve |
| `type` | `liquid \| blur` | `liquid` | Transition style |

`default` and `target` accept a component or a configured element. Endpoint props (color, size, aria) are independent. SSR renders the endpoint selected by `status` (no morph).

### type="liquid"

Morphs sampled SVG stroke geometry between icons. Unmatched strokes collapse to their centroid and fade. Best for outline/stroke icons. Different viewBoxes are normalized into a shared space. Filled icons or icons with no sampleable geometry automatically fall back to `blur`. Nested transforms / `<use>` / gradients are not specially handled.

### type="blur"

Scales down, blurs, and fades out, swaps the icon at the midpoint, then scales up, unblurs, and fades in.

## Behavior notes

- Mark the parent as a Client Component (`"use client"`) when using Next.js App Router.
- Toggling `status` mid-animation reverses from the current progress.
- When `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set, the component snaps to the endpoint with no animation.
- Package name on npm: `react-icon-transition`.
